plan.profit_plan: Sell about a third at each target. After target 1, move your stop to your entry price so the rest cannot turn into a loss. If price closes a day below the 20 day average before the targets, sell the rest: that exit beat fixed holding in the backtest.
plan.cancel: Plan is wrong if price closes below 0.0207812. Sell there, no exceptions.
